title: groupby 聚合、merge 维表与 csv 往返
expected_output:
df =
city  sales
  BJ     10
  SH     20
  BJ     30
  SH     40
  BJ     50
--- groupby('city')['sales'].sum() ---
{'BJ': 90, 'SH': 60}
--- 多种聚合 ---
      count  sum  mean
city                  
BJ        3   90  30.0
SH        2   60  30.0
--- 与维表 merge ---
city  sales mgr
  BJ     90   A
  SH     60   B
--- csv 往返 ---
csv 文本 :
city,sales
BJ,10
SH,20
BJ,30
SH,40
BJ,50
说明: to_csv 的 lineterminator 默认取 os.linesep，
      Windows 上是 CRLF，跨平台比对文本会不一致 -> 显式指定 LF
往返内容一致 : True
dtype 对照 : ['str', 'int64'] -> ['str', 'int64']
code:
import io
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city": ["BJ", "SH", "BJ", "SH", "BJ"],
    "sales": [10, 20, 30, 40, 50],
})
print("df =")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
g = df.groupby("city")["sales"].sum()
print("--- groupby('city')['sales'].sum() ---")
print(g.to_dict())
print("--- 多种聚合 ---")
print(df.groupby("city")["sales"].agg(["count", "sum", "mean"]).to_string())
left = pd.DataFrame({"city": ["BJ", "SH"], "mgr": ["A", "B"]})
merged = g.reset_index().merge(left, on="city", how="left")
print("--- 与维表 merge ---")
print(merged.to_string(index=False))
print("--- csv 往返 ---")
buf = io.StringIO()
df.to_csv(buf, index=False, lineterminator="\n")   # 显式 \n，见下方说明
text = buf.getvalue()
print("csv 文本 :")
print(text.rstrip())
print("说明: to_csv 的 lineterminator 默认取 os.linesep，")
print("      Windows 上是 CRLF，跨平台比对文本会不一致 -> 显式指定 LF")
back = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text))
print("往返内容一致 :", back.equals(df))
print("dtype 对照 :", list(df.dtypes.astype(str)), "->", list(back.dtypes.astype(str)))
